title: Fleur-de-Lis Dreamweaver
description: A surreal painting on black background features a large glowing white fleur-de-lis containing a split-face woman with colorful patterns. An infinity-shaped serpent with orange, green, and purple scales wraps around a brown horse with spiral patterns, ridden by a black cat holding a staff. Ornate floral and vine motifs, pink flowers, and a small stone structure fill the lower portion.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting with a glowing white fleur-de-lis framing a woman's face split into colorful patterned halves.
